target.title: fix(config): preserve nested defaults across deep merges
target.body:
Closes #105932

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where applying a narrow nested session retry override could discard sibling provider retry defaults. It also prevents config include, TTS, session settings, and Voice Call deep-merge behavior from drifting across separate security-sensitive implementations.

## Why This Change Was Made

Promotes the existing `defu@6.1.5` workspace pin to direct root and Voice Call runtime dependencies. Core callers share one adapter with explicit array and undefined policies; both adapters preserve explicit nulls and block `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype`. The workspace override stays so transitive `^6` ranges cannot resolve a second version. The unrelated SQLite equality helper remains local; no second dependency was added.

AI-assisted: yes. Mandatory autoreview completed with no accepted or actionable findings after its sentinel-decoding finding was fixed and regression-tested. A final review of the zero-suppression adapter was also clean.

## User Impact

Existing config include, TTS, and Voice Call precedence remains unchanged for arrays, null, and undefined. Nested session retry overrides now keep sibling defaults. No config migration or new config surface is required.

## Evidence

Blacksmith Testbox leases: `tbx_01kxcr5qx3x49aqhvcj8mrvzzp`, `tbx_01kxcsmra1sfmzvg32whvekwpy`, `tbx_01kxcv01564d6yme3a698mxbew`

- `node scripts/generate-npm-shrinkwrap.mjs --check`
- `node scripts/generate-npm-shrinkwrap.mjs --check --package-dir extensions/voice-call`
- `pnpm test src/infra/deep-merge.test.ts src/config/includes.test.ts src/tts/tts-config.test.ts src/agents/sessions/settings-manager.test.ts extensions/voice-call/src/deep-merge.test.ts extensions/voice-call/src/telephony-tts.test.ts test/scripts/type-suppression-inventory.test.ts` — 91 tests passed across four Vitest shards
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/infra/deep-merge.ts extensions/voice-call/src/deep-merge.ts extensions/voice-call/src/deep-merge.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `pnpm tsgo:core:test`
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions`
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test`
- `pnpm build`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` — clean, confidence 0.90

The affected merge-helper format, tests, production types, core test types, dependency artifacts, build, and final autoreview are green. The same 91-test set and type lanes passed again after syncing the repaired `main`; exact-head PR CI remains the landing authority.
